Been wanting to leave a review for a while after multiple bad experiences but never got around to it. Latest thing is my son going to ED 3 nights ago, bloods taken and antibiotics given. They allowed me to take my son home and said they will call if needed. I asked the surgery for the results the next day to get a full lecture from a rude receptionist about the fact that it's the ED department responsibility to give the results. After 3 days of stating I would just like to have the results for peace of mind. My son has also lost alot of weight recently so i want to check if theres anything chronically wrong as well as acutely. They flat out refused. Each time just rude, no compassion for a worried parent. I don't understand how a primary care service can't give out blood test results for a pt.

Also argued with the receptionist for the 1st day as they was stating they didn't have the results. It was confirmed the results were received at 11.17 3 days ago. One receptionist would state they have them but the doctor needs to review and the other deny all receipt of them. When I stated the time and date they were sent, the receptionist instantly got defensive as she knows she'd been giving me the wrong info for the whole day and that's when she started lecturing me on the politics of which care provider is responsible for giving the results instead of just apologising for telling me they had never received them when they did.

Just a worried mum with a simple request, 5 mins out of their day to put my mind at ease but instead, I'm stuck in a dispute between the surgery and the hospital. I feel like they are battling with me for the need to be 'right' when I just want to know my son is OK. Will be taker this
